st.t: Find Islwyn and Eluned in the woods of Isafdar, either north-east of Tyras Camp or west of Lletya. If they aren't there, hop worlds until they appear. Talk to Islwyn to start the quest. If he doesn't offer it, talk to Eluned.
s: Yes, I should go see him now.

st.t: Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya.
Kill a mourner travelling through the Arandar pass. This is more easily accessed from the north entrance. You'll need 7 free inventory spaces.
Pick up everything the mourner dropped.

st.t: Teleport to Lletya using a crystal teleport seed and talk to Oronwen to have them repair your trousers. Buy dyes here if you still need them.

Talk to the gnome on a rack.

st.t: You need to make some dyed toads. Go to Feldip Hills (AKS), use a dye on your empty bellows, then use the bellows to inflate a toad. Get at least one toad of each colour.

Dye one sheep of each colour north of Ardougne. The red flock is closest to the city, green is north-east of red, yellow is furthest north, and blue is far to the west. Use the matching toad on the fixed device and wield it. Near the flock, choose Aim and Fire in your combat options, aim the crosshair at a sheep and press the red button in its centre. A miss uses up the toad.
Equip the full mourners outfit and enter the Mourners' Headquarters in West Ardougne.
Go down the trapdoor in the north west corner of the HQ.
Talk to Essyllt in the south room.

e: Mourner (level 11) (will decrease all combat skills to 20, including Hitpoints)

st.t: Squeeze through the gap in the western fence north-west of the Mourner HQ and pick up the rotten apple there.
Talk to Elena in north-west of East Ardougne.
Go to the apple orchard directly west of the Combat Training Camp, north-east of the Outpost, and pick up a barrel there.
Use the barrel on a rotten apple pile.
Use the rotten apples on the apple press.

Make some Naphtha. Grab another barrel, fill it on the swamp south of the elven lands, then refine it on the fractionalising still at the Chemist in Rimmington with 10-20 coal. To do this, rotate the 'Tar regulator' wheel twice. Wait until the 'Pressure' indicator is in the green, then rotate the 'Pressure valve' regulator clockwise once. Now all you need to do is occasionally tap the 'Add coal' text to add coal, to push the 'Heat' into the green. Be careful to do this slowly so as to not hit the orange heat and ruin the tar.
i: Barrel of coal tar + 10-20 coal, or a barrel of naphtha

st.t: Use a barrel of naptha on the apple barrel.
Use the sieve on the naphtha apple mix
Cook the toxic naphtha on a range. DO NOT USE IT ON A FIRE, and MAKE SURE TO HAVE TWO FREE INVENTORY SPACES.
Use the toxic powder on the food store in the room north west of West Ardougne's town centre.
Use the toxic powder on the food store in the church south of West Ardougne's town centre.
Return to Essyllt in the Mourner HQ basement.
